contract.cleanup: Every trace normal-closes its sockets; finally cleanup independently aborts control requests, accepts any already obtained pending upgrade for closure, closes every local endpoint, discards held echoes, closes recipient sockets, joins normalization and records unresolved resources. Separately owned supervisor must reap only owned processes/sockets and destroy fresh storage. Any incomplete cleanup or unknown entry is BLOCKED/FAIL, never PASS.
contract.distinctness: Empty frames are messages, unlike EOF/zero chunks in stream suites; Unicode stays one valid text frame.
